name: mvp_loop state SURVIVES the real entry point — GET /api/projects between the runTests pause and the owner turn must not strip the gate (PHASE-54 R-39, closes the R-38 fidelity gap)
description: The only PHASE-54 scenario that crosses the live HTTP surface. Boots the workspace API server in-process on a temp root, seeds a project held at AWAITING_OWNER_REVIEW, drives GET /api/projects (listProjects -> persistProjectState -> buildProjectState) exactly as the UI does, then asserts the mvp_loop block and loop_id survived byte-identically and that the owner's next turn through POST /api/ai-os/chat still reaches the MVP review branch instead of falling through to ideation.
